sector_hint: premium automotive OEM in EV transition, majority-owned by a strategic shareholder
notes: Volvo Car AB listed on Nasdaq Stockholm in October 2021 (B shares, one vote each; A shares, ten votes, are unlisted and held by Geely). Pre-IPO years exist in the IPO prospectus and annual reports: use them for the series, but mark valuation as not assessed for dates before the listing. Reporting currency SEK, amounts in SEK millions, fiscal year ends 31 December. Non-operating items matter here: the equity-accounted share of Polestar's results and impairments of the Polestar stake, and gains or losses on other Geely-related holdings; keep them out of core operating margins and report them under non_operating. Ownership: Geely Holding owns the large majority of shares and all A shares, so free float is limited; note any changes in Geely's stake and insider dealings. Leverage: separate industrial net cash/debt from any customer-financing liabilities where the annual report does so. Valuation uses the VOLCAR B price in SEK; the base_currency view is EUR.
